Chapter 6502: Of Course I Know

Chapter 6502: Of Course I know

“Can you activate it?” Trinity couldn’t help but ask.

“Of course I know.” Seventy-two rode the tiger and couldn’t get down: “I have the mantra.”

Poye also passed down a mantra to him for activating the flame. The others heaved a sigh of relief.

At the very least, they still had the proper mantra or it would have been embarrassing, not to mention certain death.

“Then we shall go all out.” They no longer hesitated.

“Open!” Seventy-two shouted and began chanting a mantra while forming mudras with both hands.

He channeled his power into the tube. It indeed lit up with ancient runes twisting and focusing on the lock.

His mantra seemed effective as the runes turned the lock, issuing clicking noises.

“Click.” The lock turned far enough to reveal a virtually unnoticeable aperture.

Nevertheless, one could see the dying flame within during the night. Its destructive power frightened everyone.

“This is it...” The primal ancestors shuddered. They wouldn’t have dared to play with fire if it weren’t for the two dream realms’ empowerment.

“Open it.” They urged Seventy-two to use it.

“Very well, to ashes with you!” Seventy-two became excited once more, ready to burn all enemies to cinders.

“Open!” He roared and poured everything into the tube but this didn’t work despite the unsealing.

“Open!” The primal ancestors channeled their power through him.

“We shall help.” The Lord of Paragon and the longevity spirit also sent him additional help.

“Boom!” The lock turned, allowing more of the aperture to be visible.

“Click!” A terrible heat took over Old World.

Everyone was horrified, feeling as if they were trapped in a volcano on the verge of erupting.

“Ahh!” Seventy-two’s body couldn’t handle the waves of powers from the primal ancestors and the two major realms. Cracks appeared everywhere with blood gushing out. An implosion might happen at any second.

“Grand momentum!” He released his primal anima and started chanting something else.

A particular region in Old World resonated and delivered a rainbow of vitality and grand dao to him.

“The momentum and vitality from Seventy-two Skyraiser Sect.” A spectating emperor revealed.

He activated the momentum of his sect, and its members answered his call, aware their progenitor needed assistance.

They chanted as well, activating the momentum on top of sending their vitality toward him. Since they learned the same mantra, this process was seamless.

“Boom!” His body became as tough as a raging dragon, able to fuse all the incoming powers into one.

“Grand momentum!” Trinity and the others saw this and decided to do the same.
